map.依据石灰浓度、浸灰时间与皮重，估算皮胶原的膨胀率并评价膨胀质量，帮助控制浸灰工序: Uses lime concentration, liming time and hide weight to estimate the swelling rate of collagen and rate the swelling quality, helping control the liming stage so excessive swelling does not damage fibre structure or affect leather feel.
map.按浸灰液浓度与作用时间估算生皮膨胀率，控制充水与纤维分散程度。: Estimate the swelling rate of raw hide from liquor concentration and contact time, controlling hydration and fibre separation.
map.判断膨胀是否落在 30%~45% 的适宜区间，避免过度膨胀损伤纤维。: Judge whether swelling falls in the suitable 30%-45% band to avoid fibre damage from over-swelling.
map.按膨胀率计算皮张吸水增重的质量，用于后续工序投料折算。: Compute the added water weight of the hide from the swelling rate, for material accounting in later stages.
map.：膨胀率(%) = 浓度 × 时间 × 0.08，结果限制在 0~60；膨胀质量: Swelling rate (%) = concentration × time × 0.08, capped at 0-60; swelling mass (kg) = hide weight × swelling rate ÷ 100. Status: 30%-45% is suitable; below 30% hydration is insufficient, so extend the time or raise the concentration; above 45% is over-swelling and may damage fibres.
map.：浓度 5、时间 8 h：膨胀率 = 5×8×0.08 = 3.2%？偏低——按: At concentration 5 and 8 h the swelling rate is 5×8×0.08 = 3.2%, which is low, so this model needs larger parameters. At concentration 25 and 20 h, 25×20×0.08 = 40%, inside the suitable band; with a hide weight of 100 kg the swelling mass is 100×40/100 = 40 kg. At concentration 30 and 25 h, 30×25×0.08 = 60%, which reaches the cap and is judged excessive.
map.膨胀率过大有什么危害？: What are the dangers of excessive swelling?
map.过度膨胀会使纤维过度分散、皮张松软甚至损伤粒面，成革易松面且强度下降；应通过降低: Over-swelling disperses the fibres excessively, softens the hide and can damage the grain, so the tanned leather is prone to slackening and lower strength. Control it by lowering alkali concentration or shortening the time.
map.为什么要限制在 60% 以内？: Why is the result capped at 60%?
map.模型为经验线性外推，超过约 60% 已脱离正常工艺范围，继续外推不再有参考价值，: The model is an empirical linear extrapolation; beyond about 60% it leaves the normal process range and further extrapolation has no reference value, so it is capped.
